note: Brand introductions printed on quotations: about, three stage-wise benefits (points) and one next step. hold=1 is not printed until the owner confirms it.

brands.tagline: Japan's pioneer in toilets and Washlets
brands.about: TOTO was founded in 1917 in Kitakyushu, Japan, as Toyo Toki, and has grown into one of the world's best-known bathroom makers. In 1980 it launched the WASHLET, and more than 70 million have been sold worldwide since. Its own technologies are built into the ceramics: the CEFIONTECT glaze (developed in 1997) is ultra-smooth so dirt and bacteria do not cling, TORNADO FLUSH swirls a powerful flush around a rimless bowl using less water, and EWATER+ mists the bowl with electrolysed water after every use. TOTO has made in India since August 2014, at its own factory in Halol, Gujarat, with its Indian head office in Mumbai. For your home this means a bathroom that stays cleaner with less effort, uses less water and keeps working the way it did on day one.
points: Planning and rough-in: wall-hung and floor models with set outlet distances, so the plumber fixes the right drain and supply points once
Tiling and fit-out: CEFIONTECT glaze and rimless bowls stay clean with a wipe, so the finished bathroom looks new for years
Handover and daily use: WASHLET comfort, quiet water-saving flush, and TOTO India's own factory and service behind it
brands.next: Fix the toilet and WASHLET models before rough-in, so the drain point and electrical socket are placed correctly.

brands.about: Grundfos was founded in 1945 in Bjerringbro, Denmark, by Poul Due Jensen and is still headquartered there. About 86 percent is owned by the Poul Due Jensen Foundation, which keeps the company focused on long-term engineering rather than short-term profit. Grundfos makes more than 16 million pump units a year, including circulators, pressure boosting systems, submersible and centrifugal pumps, with its own motors and controls, and works in more than 60 locations worldwide. Its fire-fighting pumps meet FM, NFPA 20, LPCB, VdS and EN 12845 standards. For a home, that means steady water pressure on every floor, hot water that arrives quickly, quiet running and service backup from a global leader.
points: Planning: pressure boosting sized to your floors and bathrooms, so every shower gets steady pressure
Plumbing rough-in: hot-water circulators that bring hot water to the tap in seconds and save water while you wait
Handover and daily use: quiet, efficient Danish pumps with dependable service backup
brands.next: Share the number of floors and bathrooms, and we will size the pressure pump and the circulator for your home.

brands.tagline: Israeli drainage pipes, built for silence
brands.about: Huliot began in 1947 at Kibbutz Sde Nehemia in Israel and has made pipes and fittings since the 1960s. It now makes drainage and water-supply systems in Israel, Slovenia, Portugal and India, where its plant has run since December 2014, and is certified to ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001. Its HT PRO and Ultra Silent polypropylene drainage lines push-fit together with rubber seals, so joints are quick and leak-free, and the Ultra Silent line is mineral-reinforced, so you hear far less water flowing through the walls and shafts.
points: Plumbing rough-in: push-fit joints with seals, faster than solvent or threaded drainage
Shafts and walls: Ultra Silent pipes cut flowing-water noise in bedrooms and living rooms
For the life of the building: polypropylene that handles hot wastewater without cracking
brands.next: Share your drainage layout, and we will prepare the HT PRO or Ultra Silent schedule.

brands.tagline: Portuguese PPR water pipes, Huliot Group
brands.about: Heliroma Plasticos is a Portuguese maker of thermoplastic piping based in Albergaria-a-Velha, and has been part of the Huliot Group since 2019. Its PPR pipes and fittings carry hot and cold drinking water and are joined by heat fusion, so pipe and fitting melt into one continuous piece with no threads or glue to leak. PPR does not corrode or scale, keeps water hygienic, and holds European certifications including AENOR and DVGW.
points: Plumbing rough-in: heat-fused joints that become one piece with the pipe
Concealed in walls and floors: no corrosion, no scale and no leaking threads
For the life of the building: hygienic hot and cold water to every tap
brands.next: Share your plumbing layout, and we will prepare the PPR pipe and fitting schedule.

brands.about: FIMA Carlo Frattini is a family-run Italian faucet maker, founded by Carlo Frattini in 1960, with its factory in Briga Novarese, in northern Italy's tap-making district. The whole production cycle stays in-house, from machining and polishing to plating and assembly. FIMA plates with trivalent chrome rather than hexavalent chrome, runs a zero-emission galvanic line, and has its own PVD plant for colour finishes that resist scratches and fading. Its range covers bathroom and kitchen mixers, thermostatic and concealed shower systems, and handles in more than twenty finishes, from Chrome and Black Matt to Gold, Champagne and Bronze. FIMA brings genuine made-in-Italy design and craftsmanship to your bathroom, in the exact colour your design calls for.
points: Rough-in: FIMA concealed bodies go into the wall first and accept the trim you choose later, so the finish can be decided after the walls are closed
Design stage: more than twenty PVD and plated finishes, so taps, showers and handles match your tiles and hardware
Fit-out and handover: Italian-made trims with hard-wearing PVD that keeps its colour with ordinary cleaning
brands.next: Approve the concealed bodies now for rough-in, then choose the collection and finish for each bathroom from the FIMA finish samples.

brands.about: Geberit began in 1874 as a one-man business in Rapperswil, Switzerland, where the group is still headquartered. It introduced its first concealed cistern in 1964 and is today the European leader in sanitary technology, with about 11,000 employees, 26 production plants (including one in India) and sales in about 120 countries. Its Duofix frames carry wall-hung toilets and basins inside the wall, its concealed cisterns are pressure-tested before they leave the factory, and its flush plates operate them from the front. Geberit keeps spare parts for concealed cisterns and flush plates available for 50 years, so the cistern hidden in your wall stays serviceable for decades.
points: Rough-in: Duofix frames and concealed cisterns go in before plastering, at the right height for any wall-hung toilet
Plastering and tiling: a slim wall with no visible cistern, and the floor below the toilet is free to clean
Handover and for decades after: the flush plate opens for service, and spare parts are kept for 50 years
brands.next: Fix the Geberit frame and cistern before plastering, then choose the flush plate design at fit-out.

brands.about: Pentair was founded in Minnesota, USA, in 1966 and is today a New York Stock Exchange-listed water company with about 10,000 employees and annual revenue of about four billion US dollars. Its Fleck and SIATA control valves, Structural composite vessels and filtration media are used in water softeners and filters in homes and businesses worldwide. A Pentair softener or sand filter removes hardness, iron and sediment before water reaches your bathrooms, protecting skin, hair, tiles, glass and every fitting and appliance from hard-water scale.
points: Planning and rough-in: a softener and filter point at the inlet protects all the plumbing that follows
Fit-out: soft water keeps new taps, shower glass and tiles free of white scale
Handover and daily use: automatic regeneration with a time-tested control valve, so the water stays soft with little attention
brands.next: Send us a water sample or the hardness reading, and we will size the softener and filter for your daily use.

brands.tagline: Efficient heat pumps for hot water
brands.about: Green Heat Plus supplies air-source heat pumps for homes, along with swimming-pool heat pumps and solar water heating. A heat pump takes warmth from the surrounding air and moves it into the water instead of heating the water directly with an element, so it delivers plenty of hot water for a fraction of the electricity a conventional geyser uses. One central heat pump can serve all the bathrooms and the kitchen, so there is no geyser in every bathroom.
points: Planning: one central hot-water system sized for your whole family
Plumbing rough-in: hot-water lines to every bathroom from a single unit
Daily use: large savings on electricity compared with individual geysers
brands.next: Tell us the number of bathrooms and family members, and we will size the heat pump and tank.

brands.about: Stellar tanks are made by Sun Stellar at its factory at Bapauli, near Panipat in Haryana, so they are designed and built close to where you live. The tanks are made of food-grade 316L stainless steel in five- and seven-layer insulated designs, and PUF-insulated models keep stored water cooler in summer and warmer in winter. Stainless steel does not grow algae, leach plastic or crack in the sun the way plastic tanks do, so your stored water stays cleaner and the tank lasts much longer. A local factory also means quick supply and service.
points: Structure and terrace: sized and placed at the slab stage, so the stand and connections are planned
Plumbing rough-in: stainless steel outlets that connect cleanly to your supply line
Handover and daily use: algae-free, insulated water storage that lasts far longer than plastic
brands.next: Confirm the tank size and terrace position, and we will plan the stand and connections.

brands.tagline: German drainage channels for every load
brands.about: MEA Water Management is part of Germany's MEA Group, headquartered in Aichach, which has more than a century of experience in construction products. It makes surface drainage channels in polymer concrete, glass-fibre composite and stainless steel, with gratings tested to the European standard EN 1433 for loads from foot traffic to heavy vehicles. Channels lie flush with the floor and carry rainwater and wash water away along their whole length, so driveways, terraces, courtyards and basement ramps stay dry and safe.
points: Structure and floor levels: channels set into the slab with the right slope and outlet
Flooring and paving: gratings flush with tiles or stone, for a clean finished look
Monsoon and daily use: rainwater cleared fast, rated for the load on that floor
brands.next: Share your floor plan with the drive, ramp and terrace levels, and we will mark the channel runs and load classes.

brands.about: Oyster is the brand of Oyster Bath Concepts, a New Delhi company founded in 2003 that supplies shower columns, rain showers, steam cabins, enclosures and spa products. Its range is built around the shower experience, from overhead rain panels to full steam enclosures, and lets you create a spa-like bathroom at home with one specialist brand.
points: Planning and rough-in: steam generator, drain and supply points placed before the walls are closed
Tiling: enclosures and panels sized to your shower area
Handover: a spa-style shower and steam experience at home
brands.next: Share the shower area size, and we will propose the panel, enclosure or steam option that fits.

brands.about: Adani Solar is the solar manufacturing arm of India's Adani Group, which entered the business in 2017. At its 800-acre site in Mundra, Gujarat, it makes everything from ingots and wafers to cells and modules, and calls itself India's first and largest vertically integrated solar maker, having shipped more than 20 GW of modules. Its TOPCon and Mono PERC panels reach efficiencies of 21 to 23.7 percent, and Kiwa PVEL has named it a top performer nine years in a row. For your home, that means dependable power output from a large Indian manufacturer.
points: Structure: roof space and mounting points planned at the slab stage
Electrical rough-in: cabling and inverter location planned with the house wiring
Daily use: lower electricity bills from high-efficiency panels made in India
brands.next: Share your roof area and monthly electricity bill, and we will size the solar system.

brands.tagline: RO purifiers, vacuum and robotic cleaners
brands.about: Eureka Forbes was founded in Mumbai in 1982 and is listed on India's stock exchanges. Its Aquaguard brand is one of India's best-known names in drinking-water purification, and its range also includes vacuum cleaners and robotic cleaners. Its strength is a nationwide service network that has looked after Indian homes for over four decades, so help is easy to reach when you need it.
brands.note: 13 Oct 2026, his words: we only promote robotic cleaners, vacuum cleaners and RO, not softeners.
points: Plumbing rough-in: a water point and drain at the purifier location in the kitchen
Fit-out: Aquaguard RO purifiers matched to your water quality
Daily use: safe drinking water and a service network close by
brands.next: Mark the purifier position on the kitchen plan, so the water point and drain are placed.

brands.about: Sanitaar is the Stellar Sanitär range of stainless steel plumbing from the Sun Stellar group, made near Panipat. It covers 316L stainless steel pipes, double-press V-profile fittings, headers, valves and unions. Press-fit stainless steel needs no threading or welding on site: each joint is pressed in seconds with a tool, so installation is fast and clean. It resists corrosion, handles hot and cold water, and keeps drinking water free of rust and plastic taste for the life of the building.
points: Plumbing rough-in: fast, flame-free press joints and less time on site
Concealed in walls: corrosion-resistant 316L that does not scale or leak at threads
For the life of the building: clean drinking water with no plastic taste
brands.next: Share your plumbing drawings, and we will prepare the pipe and fitting schedule.

brands.tagline: German family firm for flush and drainage
brands.about: TECE was founded in 1987 in Emsdetten, Germany, and is still a family-owned company with 28 more sites around the world. It specialises in what goes behind the bathroom wall: TECEprofil and TECEbox pre-wall frames and concealed cisterns, TECEdrainline shower channels, TECEflex pipe systems and TECEfloor heating, together with designer flush plates. TECE products are engineered in Germany for clean, flat bathroom designs that are simple to install and maintain.
points: Rough-in: frames and concealed cisterns fixed before plastering
Tiling: TECEdrainline channels for level-access showers with a single slope
Fit-out: designer flush plates, with service through the plate
brands.next: Fix the frame and shower channel positions before plastering.

brands.about: LUNOS has made ventilation in Berlin since 1959 and builds its products in-house in Germany. It specialises in compact, through-the-wall ventilation units, many with heat recovery, and its e2 unit was the first fan with heat recovery to reach series production, in 2011. LUNOS brings fresh, filtered air into each room without large ducts or major building work, and it keeps bathrooms free of damp and mould.
points: Structure: wall cores planned and drilled before plastering
Fit-out: slim inner covers that sit flush with the wall
Daily use: fresh air and less damp, while keeping cooling or heating energy
brands.next: Mark the rooms that need fresh air, so the wall openings are planned before plastering.

brands.tagline: Fresh air systems for healthier rooms
brands.about: INAIR (InAir Fresh Air Systems) is a ventilation company with its Indian office in Hyderabad. It supplies fresh-air units, energy recovery ventilators, filtration, ducting and fans for homes, offices, hospitals and hotels. An INAIR system brings in filtered outdoor air and removes stale air, cutting dust and stuffiness, while recovering energy so cooling costs stay down.
points: Planning: duct routes planned with the false ceiling
Rough-in: ducting and unit positions fixed before the ceiling closes
Daily use: filtered fresh air in every room, with lower cooling load
brands.next: Share the floor plan with the ceiling heights, and we will plan the fresh-air system.

brands.about: LEO pumps are made by Leo Group Co., Ltd., founded in 1995 in Wenling, China, and listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange. The company produces pumps for domestic water supply, pressure boosting, agriculture and drainage, which are sold in many countries. LEO offers practical, cost-effective pumps for everyday household water needs, backed by a large, established manufacturer.
points: Planning: the pump sized to the head and flow you need
Rough-in: the pump and pressure tank placed for easy service
Daily use: dependable, cost-effective water supply
brands.next: Share the source and tank levels, and we will select the pump.

brands.about: Astral was founded in Ahmedabad in 1996, brought CPVC piping to India in 1998, and was the first in India to gain NSF approval for CPVC pipes. CPVC carries both hot and cold water, does not rust or scale, and is joined with solvent cement, so joints are quick and leak-resistant without threading. Astral also makes inspection chambers for underground drainage, giving your home a durable system from one of India's leading pipe makers.
brands.holdWhy: 13 Oct 2026: not a primary brand - Energy World is a sub-dealer; no introduction on quotes
points: Underground work: inspection chambers for clean, serviceable drainage
Plumbing rough-in: CPVC hot and cold lines with solvent-cement joints
For the life of the building: no rust or scale inside the walls
brands.next: Share your plumbing layout, and we will prepare the pipe and fitting list.

brands.about: IONCARE water ionizers are made in South Korea, where they are licensed as medical devices. Water passes through two filters and is then split by platinum-coated titanium plates (5, 7 or 9 plates depending on the model) into alkaline drinking water, mostly around pH 8.5 to 10, and acidic water for cleaning. The machines clean their own plates automatically, so the water stays consistent with little upkeep.
brands.confirmed: 13 Oct 2026 by Mukesh: researched on the web at his request
points: Kitchen planning: a water point and drain at the ioniser position
Fit-out: the plate count chosen to suit your family's use
Daily use: alkaline drinking water and acidic water for cleaning
brands.next: Book a home demonstration so the family can taste the water before choosing a model.

groups.tagline: One group, every pipe in the building - Israel, Slovenia, Portugal, India, Germany
groups.about: The Huliot Group is a global maker of advanced flow systems for homes and commercial buildings, with customers in more than 60 markets and factories in Israel, Slovenia, Portugal, India and Germany. It began in 1947 at Kibbutz Sde Nehemia in Israel's Upper Galilee and grew into a group: Huliot Slovenia (2014) and Huliot India (plant running since December 2014) make the polypropylene acoustic drainage lines HT PRO and Ultra Silent; Heliroma of Albergaria-a-Velha, Portugal (part of the group since 2019) makes the PPR hot-and-cold water supply pipes and fittings joined by heat fusion; Hofit (Israel, 2020) makes manholes, inspection chambers and separators. Water supply, drainage and infrastructure therefore come from one engineering family, made to ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 and certified by DIBT, SKZ, AENOR, DVGW, DTI and Australia's WaterMark. In India the pipes are made under BMTPC approval. Energy World, Panipat, is an authorised channel for the group's HT PRO, Ultra Silent and Heliroma PPR ranges.
points: Underground and rough-in: drainage, water supply and chambers from one engineering family
Walls and shafts: quiet drainage and heat-fused hot and cold lines that do not leak
For the life of the building: certified materials and one supplier answerable for the whole system
groups.next: Share your plumbing and drainage drawings, and we will prepare one Huliot Group schedule for the whole building.
